ns2:course.label: State and Local Government
ns2:course.description: The law governing the structure, powers, and operation of local governments in urban and suburban areas with analysis of political, economic, and social implications. 3 professional hours. 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: LAW 606.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: 3 professional hours. 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: LAW 606.
ns2:course.sectionDeptRestriction: Restricted to students in the Law department.
